mapper.insert: insert into user (openid, name, phone, sex, id_number, avatar, create_time) values (#{openid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{avatar}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from user where create_time < #{endTime}
select count(*) from user where create_time between #{beginTime} and #{endTime}

select count(*) from user
and create_time between #{begin} and #{end}
